description: Tell the router the hash of the deposit transaction the user just sent, so the swap is detected immediately instead of on the next scan. Optional: swaps are detected without it, and it never moves funds. swap_id is the id create_swap returned for this swap. tx_hash is the hash of the transaction that sent funds to that swap's deposit_address on the source chain (0x-prefixed on EVM chains); never pass a payout hash or another swap's id. An unknown swap_id returns an error. Use it once, right after the user shares their tx hash, then follow up with get_swap_status. Calling it again with the same hash is harmless.

tx_hash.description: Hash of the user's deposit transaction on the source chain (0x... on EVM chains). Letters and digits only, up to 128 characters.

name: report_deposit

ok.description: True when the router accepted the hash.

title: Report a deposit transaction
